versions.subject: fix: bugs in rule and title
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains: ' /lockscreenurl:'
selection1_filter:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.jpg'
        - '.jpeg'
        - '.png'
selection_reg:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'reg delete'
        - '\PersonalizationCSP'
condition: ( selection1 and not selection1_filter ) or selection_reg
